name: Iz ran rastut cvety
source:
A story of love and death. This is a tale set in a brutal world where, following yet another apocalypse, humanity has split into two distinct species.

In isolated city-states, a legend circulates about the Great Witch, a figure capable of communicating with spirits and crafting afterlives for them.

Driven by this legend, a young man journeys to an enemy city unlike any other place in the world. His origins—evident at a mere glance—place him in mortal danger.

Can he convince the Great Witch to take him on as an apprentice, despite the stigma of being a monster from birth? Or will his nature as a man-eater ultimately consume him?

[Translated from [url=https://vngames.ru/novels/detail/flowers-grow-from-wounds/]VNgames[/url]]
